summary: Zoomcar Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the sixth closing of a private placement of Series A units, each comprising one share of $1,000 stated value Series A Convertible Preferred Stock and a warrant for 20,000 common shares. On September 11, 2026, the issuer sold 156 units for approximately $155,000 under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(c), part of a $5,000,000 offering (plus $5,000,000 overallotment) terminating October 9, 2026. The preferred converts initially at $0.05 with reset provisions. Watch dilution, warrant overhang, reset mechanics, and escrow release risk.
